banner.title: WEAPONS OPENER, TABLE 48 AND TABLE 49, printed capture pp. 79-80 - the OA weapons round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture alone for this range (the settling authority): the first Mistral-OCR capture session is unavailable above p. 33, so the cross-capture agreement check is impossible. The weapons opener and equivalents prose pin from capture p. 79 (printed p. 41), T48 and T49 from capture p. 79, and the T49 footnotes from capture p. 80 (printed p. 42) - T49's page directs to the footnotes at the bottom of the next page, where they print under T50 and serve both tables. T48 pins as the 16-row equivalent-count grid, the name lists riding the column comment (textual cells, the count is the pinnable datum). T49 pins as the 69-row weight-damage grid: the weight bounds (the lone numbers as lo=hi, the spear 40-60, the two-handed sword 150-250 and the whip 25-35 as printed ranges), the S-M and L damage bounds with -99 marking the printed dashes (the lasso, the needle's blank vs-L cell), the a-h footnote letters as bitmasks, and the javelin, naginata and spear stars. No contested cells detected within the single source. OCR normalizations: the boldface two-hand set is lost to the OCR - the NOTE pins as a bool, the set does not; the T49 mace row prints no footnote letter while the T50 mace row carries h - T49 pins as printed; the kawanga row spells as printed (the R639 T47 arms list printed kawanaga) and the T49 arrow standard row spells as printed (T47 printed arrow, normal) - both pin as printed. The Weapons prose and weapon descriptions box stays open (the descriptions pin later); Table 50 (capture p. 80) is deliberately left for the next round
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 91 closed, 144 open - the Table 48 and Table 49 boxes flip (census 562 -> 563); NEXT - R641: Table 50 (Hand Held Weapons, General Data and To Hit Adjustments), capture p. 80, the hand-held AC adjustment grid, prefix dhb (verify free), audit "R641 OA handheld audit", include after rules/oaweapon.h
